method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where it says no; a NOTHING-kind answer where it does not); the dates in one module, the work rules and the complaint rules in two more, the cases in a fourth; four regulative rules (s 83(4) lodge within 12 months; s 83A(2) answer a lapse warning within 21 days; s 83A(4)(d) pursue afresh within 6 months; s 90(1) require referral of a dismissed complaint within 21 days) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Equal Opportunity Act 1984 (WA), compilation retrieved 2026-09-07 from legislation.wa.gov.au (law_a253, mrdoc 48472), compilation table ending with the Industrial Relations Legislation Amendment Act 2024 (No. 43 of 2024, in operation 31 January 2025; s 83B) and including the Births, Deaths and Marriages Registration Amendment (Sex or Gender Changes) Act 2024 (No. 31 of 2024, in operation 30 May 2025; s 4(1) gender reassigned person), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_48472.txt. No reform Bill is deposited or encoded.

seat: the employee or job applicant who says an employer discriminated against them, that they were sexually or racially harassed at work or when seeking work, or that they were victimised; and that person as complainant to the Commissioner for Equal Opportunity and applicant before the State Administrative Tribunal
focus: the provisions a claimant meets; reforms under way (none deposited: the Act as compiled, with the 2024 amendments in it)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run eoa-dates.l4 ; l4 run eoa-work.l4 ; l4 run eoa-complaints.l4 ; l4 run eoa-cases.l4
checks.result: 171 assertions written, 171 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text. Three expectations changed in a scratch copy were reported as failing.

scope: Employment and the complaint, from the employee's and complainant's seat. In: s 4(1) (complainant, complaint, employment, family responsibility or family status, gender reassigned person, impairment, near relative, race, relative, representative complaint, respondent), s 5; the meaning of discrimination in ss 8, 9, 10, 10A, 35AB, 35A, 35O, 36, 53, 66A, 66V(1), (3), 67A; applicants and employees in ss 11, 35AC, 35B, 35P, 37, 54, 66B, 66W, 67B; the work exceptions in ss 11(3), 27, 28, 29, 31, 33, 35AC(3), 35B(3), (4), 35K, 35M, 35P(3), 35ZD, 37(3), 50, 51, 54(4), 66, 66B(3), 66Q(1), (2), 66R, 66S, 66W(3), 66ZM, 66ZN(1), 66ZP, 66ZQ, 66ZS(1), 69, 72, 73(1); ss 24(1), (3), (4), 49A(1), (3), 49D, 67, 160, 161; ss 83, 83A, 83B, 89, 90, 91, 92, 93(1)-(3), 107(3), (3a), (5), 108, 123, 126, 127, 134(1), 165. Reasons in NOTES.md.
